subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should #86567 remain the umbrella tracker while maintainers split the remaining dashboard auth, OpenAI/Codex auth-health, installer atomicity, and long-session liveness work into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The remaining work crosses security-sensitive credential persistence, provider auth migration behavior, installer/update contracts, and session-state recovery, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary or security tradeoff.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split canonicals
options.body: Keep #86567 open as the coordination item and require each remaining acceptance criterion to link to a narrow owner-reviewed issue or PR with live upgrade proof.

options.title: Close umbrella after linking children
options.body: Close #86567 only after every remaining acceptance criterion is represented by an open canonical issue that maintainers agree fully supersedes this report.

options.title: Choose one maintainer-led project
options.body: Convert the umbrella into a maintainer-owned reliability project with explicit security decisions for dashboard auth persistence and OAuth profile propagation before repair work starts.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split canonicals
recommendation.body: Keep #86567 open as the coordination item and require each remaining acceptance criterion to link to a narrow owner-reviewed issue or PR with live upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent history in both the agent liveness and macOS/dashboard-adjacent surfaces and is the best available coordinator among the likely owners.
